title: Active English Contract Sample
learning_goal: Practise explaining problems, decisions, and ideas with reusable language.

default_activity.title: A critical bug before release
default_activity.learning_objective: Explain a critical issue, describe its impact, and recommend a next step to a team lead.

glossary.example_en: I noticed an issue during regression testing.
We found it during regression testing.
The bug affects the checkout flow.
It prevents users from completing their orders.
I'd recommend fixing it before the release.
glossary.pattern_note: Use recommend + -ing, not recommend to fix.

glossary.example_en: My main concern is that customers cannot place orders.

instruction.value: Read the update. Tap an underlined phrase if you want contextual help.

content.display: prevents users from completing their orders
I'd recommend fixing it before the release

prompt.value: Which phrases help the speaker do these jobs? Select one phrase for each.

source.value: I noticed a critical issue during regression testing. The bug affects the checkout flow and prevents users from completing their orders. I'd recommend fixing it before the release.

prompt.value: Complete the update. Use the meaning around each gap.

items.prompt: I noticed a ___ during regression testing.
I'd recommend ___ it before the release.

completed_text.value: I noticed a critical issue during regression testing. The bug affects the checkout flow and prevents users from completing their orders. I'd recommend fixing it before the release.

steps.title: Explain it from memory

prompt.value: The original update is hidden. Explain the problem and your recommendation to your team lead in 2–4 sentences.

natural_examples.label: A natural answer
natural_examples.text: I noticed a critical issue during regression testing. It affects the checkout flow and prevents users from completing their orders. I'd recommend fixing it before the release.

comparison_checklist: Did I say what I discovered?
Did I explain the effect on users?
Did I recommend a next step?
Did I use at least one useful phrase from the activity?

content.value: Say what you discovered, explain the effect, and recommend a next step.

steps.title: Respond to a new complication

scenario.value: Your team lead replies: “The release is tomorrow. Can we ship now and fix it next week?”

prompt.value: Reply in 2–4 sentences. Explain your main concern and give a clear recommendation.

natural_examples.label: A direct professional answer
natural_examples.text: My main concern is that customers won't be able to complete their orders. Since the bug affects a critical flow, I'd recommend delaying the release until we fix it.

natural_examples.label: A balanced alternative
natural_examples.text: We could release as planned, but the checkout issue may directly affect sales. I'd recommend fixing the critical path first and then reassessing the release.

comparison_checklist: Did I respond to the proposed release decision?
Did I explain a consequence or trade-off?
Did I make a clear, professional recommendation?
Does my wording preserve my intended meaning?

steps.heading: Useful language from this activity
steps.custom_note_prompt: Anything else you want to practise?

glossary.example_en: Do you mean all registered users?

steps.title: Ask for clarification

scenario.value: The ticket says: Send the report to users.

prompt.value: Ask which users should receive it.

natural_examples.label: Example answer
natural_examples.text: Do you mean all registered users or only active customers?

comparison_checklist: Did I ask a specific question?

default_activity.title: Explain a delay
default_activity.learning_objective: Explain a delay and set a realistic next step.

glossary.example_en: We ran into an issue with the test environment.

steps.title: Make the update clearer

prompt.value: Rewrite this update with a reason and next step: It is late. We have a problem.

natural_examples.label: Example answer
natural_examples.text: We're running into an issue with the test environment, so the update will be delayed. I'll share a revised estimate this afternoon.

comparison_checklist: Did I give a next step?

glossary.example_en: The main trade-off is speed versus maintainability.

prompt.value: Compare a quick brittle script with a slower maintainable solution.

natural_examples.label: Example answer
natural_examples.text: The main trade-off is delivery speed versus long-term maintenance. The quick script helps now, but the maintainable solution reduces future risk.

glossary.meaning_ru: Я понимаю вашу точку зрения, но…
glossary.example_en: I see your point, but we still need evidence from the test run.

steps.title: Your reply

scenario.value: A colleague says: We don't need to test this change again.

prompt.value: Disagree politely and explain why another check matters.

natural_examples.label: Example answer
natural_examples.text: I see your point, but this change affects a critical flow, so I'd still run a focused check.

comparison_checklist: Did I acknowledge the other view?

default_activity.title: Describe a small experiment
default_activity.learning_objective: Describe a result and a simple conclusion.

glossary.example_en: The result suggests that the shorter message works better.

items.prompt: The result ___ that the shorter message works better.

completed_text.value: The result suggests that the shorter message works better.

default_activity.title: Change a plan
default_activity.learning_objective: Change a plan politely and offer an alternative.

glossary.example_en: Would you mind if we met a little later?

steps.title: Make it yours

prompt.value: Ask to move an evening plan and suggest another time.

natural_examples.label: Example answer
natural_examples.text: Would you mind if we met at eight instead? I need to finish something first.

comparison_checklist: Did I suggest a clear alternative?
